02. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the Opposite Party-State.
3. This is an application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for pre-arrest bail.

4. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with S.A. Case No.39 of 2024, arising out of Komna P.S. Case No.147 of 2024, pending in the court of learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Judge,
Nuapada, for alleged commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/313/506 of the I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
5. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, the victim appears before this Court through virtual mode.
The victim stated before this Court that the Petitioner promised to marry her and thereafter kept physical relationship with her.
The Petitioner has abandoned the victim and when the victim and her family members try for the marriage, the Petitioner has threatened the victim as well as her family members with dire consequences.
She further contended that she has not interested in getting marriage to the Petitioner.

1 6.
Taking into consideration the aforesaid statement of the victim, I am not inclined to grant pre-arrest bail to the Petitioner.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the Court in seisin over the matter within a period of four weeks from today and moves an application for bail, the Court in seisin over the matter shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner in accordance with law on the same day strictly on the basis of the materials on record.

It is further directed that the Case Diary as well as relevant materials be placed before the court concerned on the date of surrender of the Petitioner for consideration of bail application of the Petitioner.
7.
The interim order passed by this Court vide order dated 09.08.2024 stands vacated.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL is disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Debasis Dhaneswar Naik vs State Of Odisha .....
